stem:
The models shown are the same size. Each model is divided into equal-size parts and is shaded to represent a fraction.

Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: \(\frac{6}{8} < \frac{8}{8}\), because sixths are smaller parts than eighths

options.label: G
options.text: \(\frac{6}{8} < \frac{8}{8}\), because 6 out of 8 parts is less than 8 out of 8 parts

options.label: H
options.text: \(\frac{6}{8} > \frac{8}{8}\), because sixths are larger parts than eighths

options.label: J
options.text: \(\frac{6}{8} > \frac{8}{8}\), because 6 out of 8 parts is greater than 8 out of 8 parts

visual_elements: Two rectangles with equal size: the first divided into 8 parts with 6 shaded, the second divided into 8 parts with all 8 shaded.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of fractions, fraction size, and comparison based on parts shaded and denominators.
